USP confirms Nelson Hideiki Nozoe as an FEA professor specializing in Brazilian economic history, coffee cultivation and industrialization, matching the 1984 São Paulo economic-history book and the USP advisor anchor.

Pedro A. Ribeiro de Oliveira published Catholic-sociology books in 1973–1985; Pedro Cassiano Farias de Oliveira wrote the 2017 UFF history doctorate on rural extension and class struggle. Different full names, research careers and doctoral chronology.

Sergio Goes de Paula wrote Morrendo à toa and the 1986 drought study and died in February 2020, as his employer records. The 2023 PUC-SP doctorate on theological training is by Sérgio Peres de Paula.

Her published autobiographical interview lists both Imprensa Negra no Brasil do Século XIX (2010) and the Unicamp doctorate Fortes laços em linhas rotas (2014), explicitly joining the book and thesis in one career.
